description: Add a swatch: a process colour, a global process colour (editing it updates every object that uses it), or a spot colour (an ink such as a Pantone colour or a varnish plate). Optionally put it in a swatch group

color.description: "cmyk(c,m,y,k)", "rgb(r,g,b)", "#RRGGBB" or "gray(g)"; a spot colour can also be "lab(L,a,b)"

global.description: Create a global process colour. Default false

group.description: Swatch group to put it in, created if needed

spot.description: Create a spot colour. Default false

name: create_swatch
title: Create Swatch
